formules.title: FROM DISCOVERY COURSE TO PRO DIPLOMA
formules.subtitle: Access to the long programme is conditional on passing the discovery course. This selective protocol guarantees everyone's safety and the standard of the cohort.
formules.step1Desc: 12 consecutive days to test your physical abilities, your composure and your ability to adapt before applying to the long programme.
formules.step1Boarding: Full board available on site (90 beds)
step1Items: Introduction to choreographed fights and camera axes
Self-height falls and landings on modular platforms
Progressive high falls up to 6-9 metres onto airbag
Individual aptitude assessment and pro admission decision
formules.step2Desc: 9 to 10 twelve-day courses spread over two years. The complete programme that trains versatile stunt performers able to work immediately for international cinema.
formules.step2Rhythm: One 12-day course every two months (2 years)
formules.step2Accreditation: QUALIOPI certified • AFDAS / France Travail funding
step2Items: Extreme falls up to 21 metres on the CUC Tower
Special forces, blank-firing weapons and tactical rappel
Direct entry into the CUC stunt coordinator network

about.title: THE LEADING FILM STUNT TRAINING CENTRE
about.description: Founded in 2008 by Lucas Dollfus, Campus Univers Cascades (CUC) is a professional training centre dedicated to physical and mechanical stunt techniques, based in Le Cateau-Cambrésis (59).
about.founderQuote: « Master the risk, create the unprecedented, push the limits of physical truth in the service of the vision of the greatest directors. »
about.imageAlt: Training stage and professional stunt performers at Campus Univers Cascades

pillars.title: DEDICATED FACILITIES
pillars.desc: Complete technical stages: landing pit, choreographed fight dojos, mechanical stunt hangars and an equestrian ring.

pillars.title: TEAM & INSTRUCTORS
pillars.desc: Supervised by working stunt riggers and coordinators, fight masters and specialists in stage combat and parkour.

pillars.title: PROFESSIONAL PLACEMENT
pillars.desc: Graduates working on feature films, TV series, live shows and international productions.

pillars.title: CUC EVENTS AGENCY
pillars.desc: Bespoke action shows, live stunts, entertainment and event demonstrations.

tournages.title: STUNT COORDINATION & FILM WORK
tournages.subtitle: A partner to film productions, TV series and broadcasters, Campus Univers Cascades provides its expertise in action design, fight direction and on-set safety, with more than 570 productions listed in its catalogue.
tournages.pillar1Desc: Shot planning, video previsualisation, bespoke choreography for shoot-outs and fights, and intensive preparation of the cast before the shoot in our Paris studio.
tournages.pillar2Title: 2. A Pool of 200+ Stunt Performers & Doubles
tournages.pillar2Desc: Stunt doubles and professional stunt performers on the largest film and streaming productions, multi-disciplinary performers (high falls, full-body burns, wire work, parkour, weapons).
tournages.pillar3Desc: Experienced stunt riggers, advanced equipment (certified airbags, 3D rigging, crash pads) and private grounds available for rehearsing complex scenes.

teamBuilding.overviewDescription: We offer activities and introductions to the stunt profession, film-making and what happens behind the scenes. Team building, seminars, public bodies... Our team of professionals offers a choice of workshops with dedicated equipment and uncompromising safety.
teamBuilding.customTitle: COMBINE SEVERAL WORKSHOPS FOR YOUR DAY
teamBuilding.customDescription: We adapt the programme, the number of stunt instructors and the equipment to your goals, your schedule constraints and the size of your group.

pillars.title: STUNT SHOWS
pillars.paragraph1: Want to energise your event with a striking show? Campus Univers Cascades places its expertise and its professional stunt teams at your service to create tailor-made live shows.
pillars.paragraph2: Medieval, contemporary or fantasy choreographed fights, spectacular high falls, pyrotechnic stunts (full-body burns): our creations adapt to every technical and staging constraint.

pillars.title: ANIMATIONS & FREEJUMP AIRBAG
pillars.paragraph1: Give your audience a unique thrill with our interactive activities supervised by professionals: the FreeJump Airbag (safe jumps from 4 to 8 metres high), a cinema wire-work simulator, or parkour introduction workshops with members of the Yamakasi.
pillars.paragraph2: Facilities fully compliant with the strictest safety standards, with professional insurance and qualified supervision.

pillars.title: ACTION CINEMA TEAM BUILDING
pillars.paragraph1: Bring your teams together for an unforgettable action seminar in the heart of the CUC grounds at Le Cateau-Cambrésis.
pillars.paragraph2: Indoor cinema workshop, physical stunts, secured fire stunts, shooting a fake action trailer: your colleagues push their limits in a spirit of camaraderie and genuine goodwill. Capacity up to 90 people with on-site accommodation and catering.

spectacles.heroSubtitle: Relive the iconic action sequences from your favourite films with the professional stunt performers and film doubles of Campus Univers Cascades. Fights, falls, parkour, humour and stage effects for all your events.
spectacles.panelTitle: TURNKEY SHOWS ADAPTED TO YOUR VENUE
spectacles.panelParagraph: Our artists belong to the very small circle of stunt doubles working on action films. Trained at Campus Univers Cascades and working exclusively with our agency, they adapt to any environment to match your expectations.

animations.heroSubtitle: Give the general public the unique sensation of free fall onto a giant cinema airbag. A spectacular activity supervised by the professional stunt performers of Campus Univers Cascades.
animations.heroImageAlt: Giant cinema Xtrem Jump airbag, CUC Events
animations.panelTitle: XTREM JUMP AIRBAG: PUBLIC INITIATION & SHOWS
animations.panelParagraph1: The general public can finally taste the adrenaline and discover the unique sensations of free fall in optimal safety, thanks to our giant airbag — the air cushion used in film-making — able to catch a professional stunt performer falling from up to 20 metres.
animations.panelParagraph2: Our agency and our team of professionals pioneered this event activity in France back in 2009. With more than 20,000 supervised jumps across Europe, our qualified stunt performers guide every participant for a memorable and safe jump.
includedItems: Giant cinema airbag certified to EU standards
Supervision by 2 to 4 professional stunt performers
animations.panelImageAlt: Jump onto the giant CUC airbag

cards.title: CUC WEEKEND IMMERSION PACKAGE
cards.description: Live the life of a film stunt performer for two full days. Sleep on campus, share meals with the team and jump onto the giant airbag in complete safety. Ideal to discover your physical abilities and get your fill of adrenaline.
details: Friday 5pm to Sunday 5:30pm (16 hours of practice)
All meals included (Friday evening to Sunday lunch)

cards.title: AFDAS COURSE — PERFORMING ARTISTS
cards.description: Give your roles total credibility in action scenes. A 70-hour AFDAS-funded course delivered in our Paris studio in Gennevilliers. Learn to take impacts, handle blank-firing weapons, fall down stairs and shoot your own action demo reel.
details: AFDAS-funded (no cost left for the artist)
Shooting of an individual action demo reel

cards.title: CUC STUNT SUMMER CAMP
cards.description: A summer week of training at the CUC: parkour, airbag jumps, cube-pit acrobatics and film fights. Residential package with accommodation and full board.
details: Residential package with accommodation and full board
